purpose: Compare source-PDF table regions and cell grids with the already stored hybrid extraction outputs.
annotation_method: Rendered original PDF pages inspected visually. Table means a visibly row/column-organized data region; prose callouts, cards, and decorative boxes are not tables.

dnd5th.selection: Fixed-seed source-PDF contact sheet; source-positive and source-negative pages retained as a diagnostic pilot, not a prevalence estimate.

ironsworn.selection: Fixed-seed source-PDF contact sheet; source-positive and source-negative pages retained as a diagnostic pilot, not a prevalence estimate.

ironsworn_targeted_diagnostic.reason: Selected after seeing the extraction ambiguity diagnostics; kept separate to avoid inflating the source-only sample.

coordinate_note: New table bounding boxes were marked from source-PDF renders with page-point coordinate grids, independently of the extracted table coordinates; rows are intentionally empty for those pages, so they support page/region scoring only. Cell-grid scoring comes only from existing draft pilot labels.
limitations: All labels remain drafts pending user confirmation.
The source-only page sample is small and intentionally balanced for diagnosis; scores are not whole-book accuracy estimates.
Bounding-box overlap threshold for a match is IoU >= 0.50.
A table page counts as correct only when at least one predicted table region matches a labeled region; extra predicted regions are false positives.
The saved extraction summary does not record the exact source-code revision or dependency lock used for extraction; the report identifies the stored output directory and source PDF hashes instead.

page_presence_definition: Visible row/column-organized data regions count as tables. Prose callouts, table-of-contents listings, diagrams, and card/stat-block layouts are excluded; uncertain cases are left unscored.
